rationale: C03 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both proclamations enlarge a national monument to preserve prehistoric ruins and use nearly identical operative language and the same sequence: public-interest findings; addition and reservation of specifically described land subject to existing rights; an express warning against damage, removal, and settlement; and assignment of supervision, management, and control to the National Park Service under the same statute. C10 and C16 share much of this monument-enlargement machinery but concern historic or geological resources rather than closely comparable prehistoric ruins.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do proclaim that, subject to valid existing rights and the provisions of existing withdrawals, the following-described tracts of land in Colorado are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the Hovenweep national Monument
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do proclaim that, subject to valid existing rights, the following-described tract of land in New Mexico is hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Aztec Ruins National Monument
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, nearly verbatim operative formula for enlarging a national monument by adding and reserving described land.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.
shared_material.explanation: The protective warning is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the National Park Service, under the direction of the Secretary of the Interior, shall have the supervision, management, and control of the lands hereby added to this monument
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the national Park Service, under the direction of the Secretary of the Interior, shall have the supervision, management, and control of this monument
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the enlarged monument to the same administrator through substantially identical statutory-management language.
